verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers a business account for managing and receiving cash in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD, which implies receiving account details exist. Its MCP server can also review company accounts and balances. However, no evidence explicitly shows a finance lead viewing account and routing numbers, and nothing mentions bank verification letters at all. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of viewing account/routing numbers, any bank verification letter generation, and self-serve on-demand access to either.
